output_verbosity.description: Verbosity flag: 'quiet', 'verbose', or empty string for none.

command.description: The specific lockfile-progs command to run (e.g., lockfile-create, lockfile-check).

args.description: Arguments for the command. Use a flat map if structured data is needed, but typically this is a list of strings/flags. For complex flags like --retry, use string items like '--retry 5'. For --lock-name, use '--lock-name filename'. For --use-pid, use '--use-pid'. The last item is usually the filename/lockname.
